read_adult_train_test_data: read the UCI Adult dataset train and test CSV files into pandas DataFrames with categorical columns
read_adult_data_keep_missing: read the Adult dataset train and test data without removing rows that contain missing values
combine_category_coding: combine categorical column categories between two DataFrames so one-hot encoding is consistent across train and test
review_read_all_data: review the read_all_data function that loads Adult dataset CSVs and returns train and test DataFrames
summarize_adult_columns: summarize the Adult dataset column definitions including categorical columns like race, sex, and occupation
